newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Nov current account surplus down 15.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan Nov current account surplus down 15.4 pct.

text.p: Japan's current account surplus, its broadest measure of trade in goods and services, dropped 15.4 percent in November from a year earlier to 664.1 billion yen, the Finance Ministry announced on Monday.
The average of forecasts by economists had been a fall of about six percent in November from a year earlier to 738 billion yen.
The figures are released in yen. At Monday morning's exchange rate of about 116 yen to the dollar, November's current account surplus was $5.725 billion.
The current account surplus has been falling on a year-on-year basis every month since December 1994. The year-on-year drop in October was 19.6 percent.
Economists had expected the pace of the drop to slow in November.

The trade surplus, a component of the overall current account figure, fell 3.4 percent in November from a year earlier to 859.8 billion yen ($7.412 billion), the 24th consecutive month it has declined on a year-on-year basis. ($1=116 yen)
